Live page 403; September 2026 capture has the quote verbatim, nav for Download Artwork, Branding Requirements, Order Decals and Card Artwork, and a Latest Updates entry marked 'Updated December 2023'.

Quote is verbatim in the Quick Take (Aug 18, 2026); the page says new enrolment closed July 21, 2026, the day the bulletin published, and that Mastercard published the end date without naming a replacement platform.
Exhibit 21.1 has the quoted heading verbatim and lists exactly the four subsidiaries and jurisdictions claimed.
curl gets 403 but WebFetch reads the page: the quote is present, the CNA decision is dated February 23, 2026, and Carnet, two of three card brands and two of four clearinghouses are all stated.
Logged-out HTML embeds a spec with "openapi": "3.1.0"; the only server URL is https://sandbox.api.visa.com and there are no securitySchemes.

The embedded spec has a webhooks object with 9 paths, including the quoted deferredoct path, and 36 operationIds in total (9 + 27); only individual fields carry 'will be deprecated' text, and no operation is marked deprecated.
The contents endpoint returns 404 with the message 'This repository is empty.'; the repository itself exists and is public.
The PyPI JSON shows version 0.0.3 uploaded 2026-08-04 with the quoted summary verbatim; the claim about six SDK languages was not separately checked in the description.
R53 shows Client incentives $(15,751) and net revenue $40,000 million for FY2025, plus four gross revenue lines (service, data processing, international transaction, other).
